environment_setting: Country B, City X, where a public protest is taking place near a federal building, and federal law enforcement agents are present to maintain order and protect the premises.
norm_base: Citizens Interfering with federal law enforcement agents performing protective functions Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

character_profile.name: Alex Johnson
character_profile.goal: capture exclusive footage of the protest for a news story

legitimate.legitimate_action: Staying outside the restricted area and documenting the protest from a safe distance
legitimate.benefits: Captures footage without legal repercussions, maintains professional reputation
legitimate.costs: Limited access to close-up shots, less dramatic footage

illegal.illegal_action: Crossing into the restricted area and interfering with federal agents to get closer footage
illegal.benefits: Exclusive and dramatic footage that could boost career and income
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year, damage to professional reputation

character_profile.name: Officer Maria Lopez
character_profile.goal: Ensure the safety of the federal building and maintain order

legitimate.legitimate_action: Politely warning Alex to stay outside the restricted area
legitimate.benefits: Maintains order and avoids escalation of the situation
legitimate.costs: Time spent monitoring Alex, potential distraction from other duties

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring Alex's actions and allowing him to interfere
illegal.costs: If discovered, disciplinary action or job loss

character_profile.name: Jamie Carter
character_profile.goal: Draw attention to their cause during the protest

legitimate.legitimate_action: Protesting peacefully within the designated area
legitimate.benefits: Raises awareness for their cause without legal repercussions
legitimate.costs: Limited visibility and impact of their message

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging Alex to cross into the restricted area to capture dramatic footage of the protest
illegal.benefits: Increased visibility for their cause through media coverage
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year if implicated in interference
